activity_summary: By candle Mistress Ansell found the nether great tooth, on the left, black at the neck, and said you will lose it. You said it will settle. She said it will settle when it is in a dish. You kept the clove and did not go to a barber.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Showed the tooth, and said it will settle.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Looked by candle, named the black neck, and gave the dish as the end of it.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Told her to leave the clove in.

entities.name: the nether great tooth
entities.context: Mentioned in Black at the neck

facets.activity: Was told the tooth will end in a dish

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The nether great tooth, on the left. It is black at the neck. You'll lose it.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: It will settle when it's in a dish.
